name: Dale Kuhn
service_areas: Oak Hollow, Grain Country, Orchard Belt
bio: 28 years walking Sample County fence lines. If it has acreage, Dale has probably sold a piece of it — from Grain Country farms to Orchard Belt fruit ground. He handles perc, easements and use-value tax enrollment day in, day out.

name: Renee Musselman
specialties: Historic homes, in-town residences, first-time buyers
service_areas: North Ridge, Sample Borough, Oak Hollow
bio: Specializes in century farmhouses and in-town historic homes near the square. Renee knows stone foundations, log cores and the honest cost of restoring an Oak Hollow homestead.

name: Trey Bushey
specialties: Raw land, first-time land buyers, wells and septic
service_areas: Mill Creek, Border Farms, Hill Country
bio: Grew up on a Mill Creek dairy farm — now helps first-time land buyers ask the right questions about wells, septic and access before they fall in love with a view.
